This bean plot is small and rented, so I will manage it carefully and avoid spending too much on purchased inputs. Since beans here usually do not get much chemical fertilizer, I will use my own labor and, if I can get some, a little manure or compost instead. I will plant local seed mixed in the intercrop, and I do not expect to irrigate or use chemicals unless there is a serious problem.
